description: Id-less boundary surfaces, from the first building of PLATEAU's L-BLDG-06 fixture: each ground, roof and wall surface is written as its own object under a bldg:boundedBy of the building, with a generated gml:id such as wallsurface_1. The reader's synthetic owner keys only match each surface's data to its geometry and never reach the output. New-world only: the legacy writer flattens nested objects onto their feature.
